# ELK.js

`elk.bundled.js` is the unmodified browser bundle from **elkjs 0.12.0**.

- Project: https://github.com/kieler/elkjs
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/elkjs/-/elkjs-0.12.0.tgz
- Package integrity: `sha512-YZcKynxVxYoKIOEpywEPwCFdg+BTbxQRNf3pbwdDCvc8O3kQD8bmIwSxKU1eOTVc4Xo+VG9Te+575mlfvOrhEQ==`
- Bundle SHA-256: `1222e44f953ce7746af23801e723708f8e6f436b8b377a6a5fc7552f34a307b3`.
- License: EPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-or-later; see `ELK-LICENSE.md`.

The page loads this local bundle directly. No CDN, runtime download, account or web server is required. ELK computes node coordinates and edge routes; the Garage viewer renders accessible HTML cards and SVG connections.
